text: The company's quarterly earnings exceeded analyst expectations, with revenue of $8.3 billion representing a 12% year-over-year increase. Operating margins improved to 23.4%, up from 21.1% in the same quarter last year, driven by cost reductions in the supply chain and stronger-than-expected demand for the premium product line. However, management cautioned that inventory levels in the consumer electronics segment remain elevated, and that tariff uncertainties could affect margins in the second half of the fiscal year. The board authorized a $2 billion share buyback program.
